第76章 林美丽挨打-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强抬起头，看了她一眼。

“我没担心你。”

林美丽愣了一下。

“路是你自己选的，人是你要嫁的。”

林国强低头继续修凳子，“过得好是你的本事，过不好也是你的事，跟我没关系。”

话说得不轻不重，但每个字都透着疏远。

林美丽脸上有点挂不住，干笑了两声：“二哥，看你这话说的，我可是你亲妹妹……”

“我说错了吗？”

林国强停下手里的活，看着她，“出嫁前我拦过你，你把我的话当耳旁风。

现在你来跟我说王超对你好，想听我说啥？

说我当初错了？说王超是个好人？”

“行，我说，王超是个好人，满意了？”

林美丽脸涨得通红。

赵素梅赶紧打圆场：“国强，你少说两句，美丽难得来一趟……”

“我没不让她来。”林国强站起来，“店里有事，我先走了。”

说完，拎着外套出了门。

自行车链条响了几声，远了。

林美丽坐在那儿，脸一阵红一阵白。

赵素梅尴尬地给她续茶：“美丽，你二哥就这脾气，别往心里去。”

“我知道。”林美丽扯了扯嘴角，“二哥是怕我吃亏。

可王超真不是他想的那样……”

话说到一半，她自己都觉得底气不足。

坐了一会儿，起身走了。

走了几步，林美丽回头看了一眼林国强家的院门。

门关着。

她咬了咬嘴唇，扭头走了。

林美丽回到家的时候，王超还没回来。

她做好晚饭，等到天黑，人才回来。

一进门，满身酒气。

“又喝酒了？”林美丽皱着眉。

王超脱了鞋，歪在椅子上：“跟厂里几个兄弟喝了两杯。

男人的事，你少管。”

林美丽忍着气，把饭菜端上来。

王超看了一眼：“就这？炒白菜？连个肉都没有。”

“咱家这个月开销不小，我省着点花……”

“我省你妈！”王超一拍桌子，“老子在外面累死累活挣钱，回家连口肉都吃不上？”

林美丽筷子一放：“王超，你说话注意点。”

“我咋了？我说错了？”

王超指着她，“你看看你，穿的老子的，吃的老子的，还敢给老子甩脸子？”

林美丽气得眼眶都红了。

她转身进了里屋，拿出一张纸。

王超的工资条。

“王超，你这个月工资四十二块。

你自己看看，交到我手里的有多少？”

她把工资条拍在桌上，“二十块！你拿了二十二块，都喝酒打牌了？”

Lin Guoqiang raised his head and glanced at her.

"I'm not worried about you."

Lin Meili was stunned for a moment.

"The path you choose is yours, and the person you want to marry is yours."

Lin Guoqiang lowered his head and continued to repair the stool, "It's your business to live well, and it's your business to live poorly. It has nothing to do with me."

The words were neither light nor serious, but every word conveyed alienation.

Lin Meili looked a little confused and laughed twice: "Second brother, judging from what you said, I am your biological sister..."

"Did I say something wrong?"

Lin Guoqiang stopped what he was doing and looked at her, "I stopped you before we got married, but you turned a deaf ear to my words.

Now you come and tell me that Wang Chao is good to you. What do you want to hear me say?

Say I was wrong?Say Wang Chao is a good person?"

"Okay, let me tell you, Wang Chao is a good man. Are you satisfied?"

Lin Meili's face turned red.

Zhao Sumei quickly smoothed things over: "Guoqiang, please stop saying a few words. Beauty comes only once..."

"I didn't let her come." Lin Guoqiang stood up, "There's something going on in the store, I'll leave first."

After saying that, he picked up his coat and walked out the door.

The bicycle chain rang a few times, but it was far away.

Lin Meili sat there, her face turning red and white.

Zhao Sumei refilled her tea awkwardly: "Meili, your second brother has this temper, don't take it to heart."

"I know." Lin Meili twitched her lips, "Second brother is afraid that I will suffer a loss.

But Wang Chao is really not what he thought..."

Halfway through her words, she felt that she lacked confidence.

After sitting for a while, he got up and left.

After walking a few steps, Lin Meili looked back at the courtyard door of Lin Guoqiang's house.

The door is closed.

She bit her lip and turned away.

When Lin Meili returned home, Wang Chao hadn't come back yet.

She made dinner and waited until dark before coming back.

As soon as I walked in, I smelled of alcohol.

"Drinking again?" Lin Meili frowned.

Wang Chao took off his shoes and leaned on the chair: "I had two drinks with some brothers in the factory.

Don't worry about men's affairs."

Lin Meili held back her anger and served the food.

Wang Chao glanced at it: "That's it? Stir-fried cabbage? Not even a piece of meat."

"Our family has a lot of expenses this month, so I'll save some money..."

"I'll save your mother!" Wang Chao slapped the table, "I work so hard outside to make money, but I can't even eat meat when I get home?"

Lin Meili put down her chopsticks and said, "Wang Chao, be careful what you say."

"What's wrong with me? Did I say something wrong?"

Wang Chao pointed at her, "Look at you, you are wearing my clothes and eating my clothes, how dare you embarrass me?"

Lin Meili was so angry that her eyes were red.

She turned around and went into the back room and took out a piece of paper.

Wang Chao’s salary slip.

"Wang Chao, your monthly salary is 42 yuan.

See for yourself, how many have been handed over to me?"

She slapped her pay slip on the table, "Twenty yuan! You took twenty-two yuan and drank and played cards?"
